description: This file contains libc hook implementations and system call stubs for Zephyr RTOS, including heap management, stdio hooks, system call wrappers, and threading locks.

methods.name: malloc_prepare
methods.description: Initializes heap based on configuration, maps memory if MMU is enabled, and sets up memory partitions.

methods.name: __stdout_hook_install
methods.description: Installs a custom hook function for stdout output.

methods.name: __stdin_hook_install
methods.description: Installs a custom hook function for stdin input.

methods.name: zephyr_read_stdin
methods.description: Reads input from stdin using the installed hook.

methods.name: zephyr_write_stdout
methods.description: Writes output to stdout using the installed hook.

methods.name: _read
methods.description: Weak alias for reading from stdin.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Weak alias for writing to stdout.

methods.name: _lseek
methods.description: Stub for seeking in files, returns 0.

methods.name: _isatty
methods.description: Checks if file descriptor is a terminal.

methods.name: _getpid
methods.description: Stub for get process ID, returns 0.

methods.name: _fstat
methods.description: Returns file status, sets mode to character device.

methods.name: lock functions
methods.description: Functions for initializing, acquiring, releasing, and closing locks, supporting multithreading.
